scope: Design, implementation, and synthetic verification only; no covariance-cache construction, N576 field generation, PM, FoF, or scientific selection was executed.

new_and_highk_regression.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_cf4_lg_highk_covariance_cache.py tests/test_cf4_lg_highk_streaming_forward.py tests/test_cf4_lg_highk_streaming_slurm.py tests/test_cf4_lg_highk_conditional_field.py tests/test_cf4_lg_highk_technical_pilot.py tests/test_cf4_lg_highk_p1_support_audit.py

audit_findings.legacy_v8_conflict: The V8 program still requires parent-centered P1 and therefore cannot be reused as the execution program. Only its SHA-pinned candidate preselection, normalized z=0 likelihood, and statistical thresholds are inherited.
audit_findings.pair_recentered_P1: retained as a downstream final environment gate
audit_findings.midpoint_importance_correction: not reapplied because the 256 rows are already equal-weight joint posterior draws

implementation_contract.covariance_cache: 250 exact AQA* matrices computed once with no fields or science selection
implementation_contract.production_batching: 16 Slurm array tasks times 16 rows, maximum concurrency four after a passing pilot
implementation_contract.persistent_outputs: Atomic per-row FoF halo catalogue plus field, P2, likelihood, identity, and timing diagnostics
implementation_contract.restart: Only verified deterministic replay of the identical schedule row is allowed; thresholds and seeds cannot change.
implementation_contract.numerical_failure: Any high-k gate failure stops before PM.

covariance_cache.basis: 1.2 times the measured 15728660 KiB high-k technical-pilot peak, rounded upward

integrated_PM_pilot.basis: 1.2 times a conservative 40 GiB pre-pilot estimate; production must use the pilot's measured MaxRSS plus 20 percent

next: After user approval, change only the cache and integrated-pilot authorization flags, refresh the program SHA pins in both Slurm scripts, commit and push, then submit the cache job followed by the four-row pilot with an afterok dependency.
